messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — gathering owners for remediation items on GPU autoscale/quota/scheduler/headroom. I'll list items, pls ack or reassign.

devon: I'll take scheduler tuning (item 2). ETA end of week. Experiment: increase preemption_threshold to 0.7 and reduce scale_down_delay to 120s. Will test on gamma.

mike: I'll own quota policy updates for reserved pools. Plan: add soft quota of 80% per team + alert at 70%. Target 2026-04-05. TAG: @kiran for infra rollback plan.

kiran: ack — will provision test quota changes in staging, make runbook for rollback. Also will add `kubectl apply -f quotas.yaml` snippet into runbook.

anya: Headroom planning & ramp tests => I'll create capacity soak tests and a traffic generator. Target: smoke in 48h, full run next week. Need list of models to include.

devon: also adding scheduler metrics dashboard panel: pending_pods_by_team and kvcache_miss_rate.

sara: created GH issue for consolidated plan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/issues/4021. @ops-bot can you create a cross-team calendar invite and a recurring check-in?

ops-bot: Created task T-3187 and calendar invite 'GPU Capacity Remediation Check' for 2026-04-06 14:00 UTC. Assigned to devon, mike, kiran, anya. :white_check_mark: 

kiran: quick note — consider burst buffer of +10% headroom during peak 17:00-21:00 UTC.

mike: +1 to buffer. Also propose canary routing fallback to smaller quantized model if queue > 500.

sara: action owners and dates: scheduler tuning — devon — 2026-04-03; quota policy — mike — 2026-04-05; headroom soak — anya — 2026-04-07; runbook & rollback — kiran — 2026-04-03. I'll update the GH issue.

anya: adding evals prompt sets to ensure quality after quantization fallback.

devon: quick code snippet for tuning:

```yaml
scheduler:
  preemption_threshold: 0.7
  scale_down_delay: 120
```

sara: thx everyone. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll start executing.

mike: noted, tagging @security for KMS notes if private models are used.
